title: 5AM PRAYER THAT SHIFTS YOUR DAY FROM STRUGGLE TO SUPERNATURAL FAVOUR
text: Glory, glory, glory to the most high God. Oh, I feel the weight of heaven in this place already. Something is different about this moment. Something is shifting in the realm of the spirit. I don't know who I'm speaking to, but the Holy Ghost arrested me and said, "Tell my people that this is not an ordinary gathering. This is a divine appointment. You did not stumble upon this message by accident. You did not click on this by coincidence. The hand of God guided you here. The spirit of the living God orchestrated this moment and I want you to understand that what you are about to receive has the power to redefine the trajectory of your entire existence. Hallelujah. Before we go any further, I want you to do something. I want you to send this message to at least three people. Share it, forward it, post it because there is someone in your contact list, someone in your circle, someone connected to you who is going through a season of struggle. They are tired, they are weary, they are on the verge of giving up. And this word might be the lifeline that pulls them back from the edge. You could be the instrument God uses to save a destiny today. You could be the channel through which breakthrough flows to a family. You could be the bridge that connects someone to their miracle. So share this message. Let it multiply. Let it spread. For the Bible says in Ecclesiastes 11:1, "Cast thy bread upon the waters, for thou shalt find it after many days." When you sow this word into someone's life, you are casting bread upon the waters and it shall return to you multiplied, increased, overflowing. Now I want us to enter into the presence of God not casually, not religiously, but with hunger, with desperation, with expectation. Wherever you are right now, I want you to close your eyes, shut out every distraction, silence every noise, and focus your heart on the King of Glory. Father, we come before you. We come before you, Lord, not because we are worthy, but because you have made us worthy through the blood of your son. We come before you not in our own righteousness, but in the righteousness of Christ Jesus. We come before you, Lord, and we worship you. We worship you. We worship you. Holy, holy, holy is the Lord God Almighty, who was and who is and who is to come. The whole earth is full of your glory. The heavens declare your majesty. The mountains bow before your presence. The seas roar at your command. And we your children, we worship you. We worship you. We worship you. Shababa bababa komos shandai robo chandela. second. Hallelujah. You may be seated in the presence of the Lord, but keep your spirit alert. Keep your heart open because God is about to speak. Glory to God. Now, I want to share something with you that I believe will transform your approach to every single day for the rest of your life. And I need you to pay very close attention because this is not entertainment. This is not information. This is revelation that carries the power to shift your reality. The theme we are dealing with is this 500 a.m. prayer that shifts your day from struggle to supernatural favor. Write that down. Meditate on it. Let it sink into your spirit. There is a prayer, a specific prayer prayed at a specific time that has the power to shift your day. Not from struggle to mild improvement. Not from struggle to manageable difficulty, but from struggle to supernatural favor. Do you understand what I'm saying? The distance between struggle and supernatural favor is often just one prayer. The difference between a day of defeat and a day of destiny is often just one engagement. The gap between frustration and fulfillment is often just one encounter. And I want to show you from scripture the significance of 5:00 a.m. The significance of the early morning, the significance of engaging heaven before the day engages you. Go with me to Psalm 63:es 1-2. David writes, "Oh God, thou art my God. Early will I seek thee. My soul thirsteth for thee. My flesh longeth for thee in a dry and thirsty land where no water is. to see thy power and thy glory. So as I have seen thee in the sanctuary, David makes a declaration. He says, "Early will I seek thee, not when I have time, not when it's convenient, not when I feel like it." Early. The Hebrew word for early here is shaka. And it literally means at dawn, at daybreak, [music] in the early morning hours, when darkness is still contending with light, [music] when night has not fully given way to day. David understood something that many believers do not understand. He understood that there is a window of time in the early morning that carries unusual spiritual significance. There is a portal that opens at dawn. There is an access that is available in the early hours that becomes contested as the day progresses. And David said, "My soul thirsts for you. My flesh longs for you. In a dry and thirsty land where no water is." Do you feel like you are in a dry land? Do you feel like you are in a season where nothing seems to be flowing? Where everything seems difficult? Where blessing seems distant and favor seems foreign? David was in that same place. He was in the wilderness. He was running from salt. He was in a dry and thirsty land. But in the midst of that dryness, he made a decision. He said, "Early will I seek thee." And that seeking led to seeing. Look at verse two. To see thy power and thy glory. When you seek God early, you position yourself to see his power and glory throughout the day. When you engage heaven at 5:00 a.m., you activate dimensions of divine intervention that would otherwise remain dormant. When you pray before the sun rises, you release forces that work on your behalf for the rest of the day. Hallelujah. Let me give you another scripture. Go with me to Isaiah 50:4. The Bible says, "The Lord God had given me the tongue of the land that I should know how to speak a word in season to him that is weary. He wakenth morning by morning. He wakenth mine ear to hear as the learned. Did you catch that? He wakens morning by morning. God himself awakens morning by morning. He awakens the ear to hear. This tells us that there is something God wants to communicate in the morning that he may not communicate at any other time. There is a frequency of heaven that broadcasts in the early hours. There is a download available at dawn that becomes scrambled as the day unfolds. [music] And God says, I will give you the tongue of the learned. The ability to speak a word in season, the capacity to bring solution, the power to bring change. This comes from the morning awakening. This flows from the 5:00 a.m. engagement. I prophesy to someone. As you begin to honor the 5:00 a.m. hour, God will give you a tongue of the lannet. You will know what to say. You will know when to say it. You will know how to say it. Words of wisdom will flow from your mouth. Words of prophecy will proceed from your lips. Words of breakthrough will be released through your voice. Receive itab. Now, let me take you deeper. The title says, "This prayer shifts your day from struggle to supernatural favor." Let me explain what this means. The word struggle in the Greek is agon is where we get the English word agony. It speaks of a contest, a conflict, a fight, wrestling, striving, effort that seems to yield minimal results. How many of you know what it feels like to struggle? To work hard and see little fruit. To pray and see no answer. To believe and see no manifestation. To give your best and receive nothing in return. That is struggle. And struggle was never meant to be your permanent address. Struggle was never designed to be your destiny. Struggle is a season, not a sentence. It is a face, not a fate. And God has made provision for you to move from struggle to supernatural favor. The word supernatural means above nature, beyond the natural, exceeding what is normal, transcending what is expected. And favor is the Hebrew word chen or the Greek word carries. It means grace. It means unmmerited blessing. It means preferential treatment that you did not earn and do not deserve. Supernatural favor is when God causes things to walk in your direction that have no natural explanation. Is when doors open that should have remained closed. Is when opportunities come that you did not create. Is when people help you who have no reason to help you. Is when you are chosen over people who are more qualified. Is when you succeed where others have failed. And I want you to understand that the 5:00 a.m. prayer is a key that unlocks this dimension. Let me show you this from scripture. Go with me to Exodus 33-14. Moses is speaking to God and he says, "Now therefore I pray thee, if I have found grace in thy sight, show me now thy way, that I may know thee, that I may find grace in thy sight, and consider that this nation is thy people." And he said, "My presence shall go with thee, and I will give thee rest." Moses asked for grace and God's response was, "My presence shall go with thee." The presence of God is the source of supernatural favor. When God's presence goes with you, favor follows. When God's presence covers you, things shift in your direction. When God's presence surrounds you, enemies become foottools. And when do we access the presence of God most powerfully? In the early morning, in the 5:00 a.m. hour, when the world is still asleep and heaven is wide awake. Hallelujah. Let me give you another dimension. In the book of Mark 1:es 35-37, the Bible says, "And in the morning, rising up a great while before day, he went out and departed into a solitary place, and there prayed. And Simon and they that were with him followed after him. And when they had found him, they said unto him, "All men seek for thee. This is Jesus Christ, the son of God, the one who spoke worlds into existence." And he rose up a great while before day. Do you know what a great while before day means? It means while it was still very dark. It means 4:00 a.m. 5:00 a.m. before dawn broke, before the sun rose. And notice what happened as a result of this early morning engagement. The disciples came looking [music] for him and said, "All men seek for thee." After Jesus prayed at 5:00 [music] a.m., everybody was looking for him. Favor was activated. Attention was drawn. Opportunities multiplied. I prophesy to you as you begin to pray at 5:00 a.m. All men shall seek for you. The right people will look for you. The right connections will find you. The right opportunities will locate you. Favor will draw men to your life. Receive it. Robbo chandela shaba baba komos shandanda. Now let me teach you why 5:00 a.m. is strategic. Because this is not superstition. This is spiritual science. In the natural realm, 5:00 a.m. is the transition point between night and day. It is the time when darkness begins to give way to light. It is the threshold between one day ending and another beginning. In the spiritual realm, this transition point is significant. It is a time when spiritual activity is heightened. It is a time when the veil between the natural and supernatural is thin. It is a time when prayers carry unusual weight and declarations have extraordinary impact. The enemy knows this. That's why witches and warlocks operate in the early morning hours. That's why covens gather between midnight and dawn. That's why evil altars are service before daybreak. But the children of God must be wiser. We must reclaim the 5:00 a.m. hour. We must occupy the territory that belongs to the kingdom. The Bible says in Isaiah 14:12, "How art thou fallen from heaven, oh Lucifer, son of the morning." Did you see that? Lucifer was called son of the morning. He was assigned to the morning realm. And even in his fallen state, he still contends for that territory. But Jesus Christ is called in Revelation 22:1 16, the bright and morning star. Jesus is the bright and morning star. He has reclaimed the morning. He has taken back what the enemy stole. And when you engage heaven at 5:00 a.m., you align yourself with the bright and morning star. and you displace [singing] the powers of darkness. Hallelujah. Let me give you yet another scripture. This is powerful. In the book of Lamentations 3 22- 23, the Bible says, "It is of the Lord's mercies that we are not consumed because his compassions fail not. They are new every morning. Great is thy faithfulness." His mercies are new every morning. Do you understand what this means? Every morning, God releases a fresh patch of mercy. Every morning there is a new supply of compassion. Every morning there is a fresh dispensation of grace. But here's the key. You must be awake to receive it. You must be engaged to access it. You must be present to [singing] partake of it. If you sleep through the morning, you miss the fresh mercy. If you neglect the 5:00 a.m. hour, you forfeit the new compassion. If you ignore the early morning engagement, you lose the fresh grace and then you wonder why your day is filled with struggle is because you miss the mercy that was designated for that day. You forfeited the compassion that was assigned to that morning. You lost the grace that was allocated for that season. But I prophesy to someone from this day forward you will not miss your morning mercy. You will not forfeit your daily compassion. You will not lose your allocated grace. You will rise at 5:00 a.m. You will engage heaven. You will receive what God has prepared for you. Receive it. Shaba shandai robo chandela. Now let me show you how struggle operates. Because if you are going to shift from struggle to supernatural favor, you must understand how struggle works. Struggle is not random. Struggle is strategic. The enemy designs struggle to accomplish specific purposes in your life. First, struggle is designed to drain your strength. When you are constantly fighting, constantly striving, constantly wrestling, your energy is depleted. And when your energy is depleted, you become vulnerable. You make [music] poor decisions. You accept less than God's best. You settle for mediocrity. The Bible says in Nehemiah 4:10, "And Judah said, the strength of the bearers of burdens is decayed, and there is much rubbish so that we are not able to build the wall." The strength of the bearers of burdens was decayed. They were too tired to build. They were too exhausted to complete their assignment. This is what struggle does. It decays your strength until you're too weak to build your destiny. But when you pray at 5:00 a.m., God renews your strength. Isaiah 40 30-31 says, "Even the youth shall faint and be weary, and the young men shall utterly fall, but they that wait upon the Lord shall renew their strength. [music] They shall mount up with wings as eagles. They shall run and not be weary, and they shall walk and not faint. When you wait upon the Lord in the 5:00 a.m. hour, your strength is renewed. [music] You mount up with wings as eagles. You run and do not grow weary. You walk and do not faint. Second struggle is designed to steal your time. While you're struggling with problems that should have been solved, time is passing. Seasons are changing. Opportunities are expiring [music] and you're stuck in the same place, fighting the same battles year after year. The Bible says in Ecclesiastes 3:1, "To everything there is a season and a time to every purpose under the heaven." There is a time for every purpose. But if you are stuck in struggle, you miss your time. You forfeit your season. You lose your window of opportunity. But when you pray at 5:00 a.m., God redeems your time. He accelerates your progress. He compresses years into days. What should take a decade happens in a year. What should take a year happens in a month. What should take a month happens in a week. I decree over your life. [music] Time is redeemed. Wasted years are restored. Lost seasons are recovered. You shall accomplish in days what others accomplish in years. Receive it. Robbo chandela shaba baba. Third, struggle is designed to steal your joy. When you are constantly battling, you have no energy left for celebration. When you're always fighting fires, you have no capacity for rejoicing. When every day is a war, you forget what peace feels like. The Bible says in Nehemiah 8:10, "The joy of the Lord is your strength." Joy is connected to strength. When you lose your joy, you lose your strength. When you're joyless, you're powerless. But when you pray at 5:00 a.m., God restores [music] your joy. Psalm 30:5 says, "Weeping may endure for a night, but joy cometh in the morning." Joy comes in the morning, not at noon, not in the evening, in the morning. When you engage the 5:00 a.m. hour, joy is released. When you pray before dawn, gladness is restored. When you worship while others sleep, happiness returns. I prophesy to someone, your joy is being restored right now. The heaviness is lifting. The depression is breaking. The sadness is departing. Joy is flooding your soul. Gladness is filling your heart. Happiness is returning to your life. Receive it. Shaba shandai. Hallelujah. Now, let me show you what supernatural favor does. Because when you shift from struggle to supernatural favor, everything changes. Supernatural favor opens doors that were closed. In Revelation 3:8, Jesus says, "I know thy works. Behold, I have set before thee an open door, and no man can shut it. No man can shut it." When God opens a door through supernatural favor, no enemy can close it. No opposition can reverse it. No adversary can cancel it. I decree over your life doors are opening, doors of opportunity, doors of provision, doors of connection, doors of advancement, doors of breakthrough, and no man shall shut them. Supernatural favor causes people to help you. In Ezra 7 27-28, Ezra says, "Blessed be the Lord God of our fathers, which had put such a thing as this in the king's heart, to put the house of the Lord, which is in Jerusalem, and had extended mercy unto me before the king and his counselors, and before all the king's mighty princes." God put it in the king's heart. The king had no natural reason to help Ezra, but supernatural favor caused the king to extend mercy, to provide resources to support the mission. I decree over your life, God is putting it in hearts to help you. Kings shall extend mercy to you. Princes shall support your vision. The wealthy shall fund your assignment. The powerful shall advocate for you. Supernatural favor accelerates your progress. In Genesis 39:2-3, the Bible says, "And the Lord was with Joseph, and he was a prosperous man, and he was in the house of his master, the Egyptian, and his master saw that the Lord was with him, and that the Lord made all that he did to prosper [music] in his hand." Everything Joseph touched prospered. His master saw it. The favor was visible. The blessing was undeniable. I decree over your life, everything you touch shall prosper, your business shall prosper, your career shall prosper, your ministry shall prosper, your relationship shall prosper, your investment shall prosper, men shall see the Lord with you, supernatural favor distinguishes you. In Exodus 33:16, Moses asked God, "For wherein shall it be known here that I and thy people have found grace in thy sight? Is it not in that thou goest with us? So shall we be separated, I and thy people, from all the people that are upon the face of the earth." Favor separates you. Favor distinguishes you. Favor marks you as different. Favor sets you apart from the crowd. I decree over your life. You are distinguished. You are marked. You are set apart. When people look at you, they know something is different. When they observe your life, they recognize the hand of God. You carry an aroma of favor that cannot be denied. Hallelujah. Now, I'm going to shift. We're going to enter into prayer. And I need everyone to stand to their feet. This is the moment everything changes. This is the hour your struggle ends. This is the prayer that shifts your day from struggle to supernatural favor. Wherever you are, whether you're in your bedroom, your living room, your car, your office, wherever you are, I want you to stand. If you cannot stand, lift your hands, but engage, participate, enter in. Shababa komos shandai robo chandela. Father in the name of Jesus, we come before your throne. We come as your children. We come with boldness. We come with confidence. For you have given us access through the blood of Jesus. And we declare right now that struggle is ending. Supernatural favor is beginning. The shift is happening in the name of Jesus. Now, I want you to pray with me. Open your mouth and speak this word. Say this. Father, I thank you for this 5:00 a.m. hour. I thank you for the privilege of engaging heaven before the world awakens. I thank you for the portal that is open. I thank you for the access that is available. I thank you for the mercy that is fresh. I thank you for the compassion that is new. Say this. I declare that this day is shifting. I am moving from struggle to supernatural favor. Every battle I've been fighting is coming to an end. Every war I have been waging is concluding in victory. Struggle has lost its grip on my life. Shaba shandai say this. I release the word of God over this day. I declare that goodness and mercy shall follow me. I declare that favor surrounds me as a shield. I declare that the Lord goes before me and prepares my way. I declare that angels are assigned to my life. I declare that divine protection covers me. Now lift your voice and begin to pray in the Holy Ghost. Robbo chandela shaba komos shandai seceshai barro shandai kamandeshi robo chandela fire fire. I'm praying for you right now. I'm standing in the gap for you. Every chain of struggle that has held you bound, I [music] command it to break now. Every rope of limitation that has tied you down, I command it to snap now. Every wall of opposition that has blocked your progress, I command it to crumble now. You are free. You are free. You are free. Shaba baba shandai. Now let's pray over specific areas. I want you to engage with all your might. Let's pray over your destiny. Father, in the name of Jesus, I speak over my destiny. I declare that my destiny is activated. I declare that my purpose is ignited. I declare that my assignment is empowered. Every force that has been contending against my destiny, I command it to scatter now. Every power that has been working to delay my manifestation, I command it to be paralyzed now. Every agenda that has been designed to abort my purpose, I command it to be cancelled now. My destiny is protected. My destiny is preserved. My destiny is manifesting. I declare that from this day forward, I walk in the fullness of what God has ordained for my life. I step into the completeness of what heaven has designed for me. I enter into the totality of what the father has purposed for my existence. No more delays, no more detours, no more distractions. My destiny is on track. My destiny is accelerating. My destiny is manifesting. Robbo chandela shaba baba komos shandai. Now let's pray over your family. Father in the name of Jesus, I cover my family with the blood of Jesus. I declare supernatural favor over my household. I declare divine protection over every member of my family. Every attack that has been launched against my family, I cancel it now. Every curse that has been spoken over my bloodline, I break it now. Every covenant of darkness that has been operating in my family, I terminate it now. I release salvation into my family. Every unsaved member, I declare that the veil is lifted from their eyes. The gospel penetrates their hearts. They encounter the love of Christ. They surrender to Jesus. I release healing into my family. Every sick member, I declare divine health over their bodies. Every afflicted member, I declare restoration over their systems. Sickness flees, disease departs, health returns. I release prosperity into my family. Every struggling member, I declare financial breakthrough. Every member in lack, I declare abundance. Poverty is broken. Insufficiency is ended. Wealth flows. My family is blessed. My family is favored. My family is protected. My family is prosperous. My family is saved. Shaba komos shandai robo chandela. Hallelujah. Now let's pray over your finances. Father, in the name of Jesus, I speak over my financial life. I declare that the curse of struggle is broken. I declare that supernatural favor is released over my finances. I command every financial door that has been closed against me to open now. I command every opportunity that has been withheld to be released now. I command every contract that has been delayed to be signed now. Command every payment that has been held back to be disbeds now. I break the spirit of poverty. I break the spirit of lack. I break the spirit of insufficiency. I break the cycle of financial struggle that has plagued my life and my family. I declare that wealth is my portion. I declare that riches are my inheritance. I declare that abundance is my reality. I am blessed coming in and blessed going out. I lend and do not borrow. I am the head and not the tail. I am above and not beneath. My business is blessed. My career is blessed. My investments are blessed. My bank account is blessed. Everything my hands touch is blessed. Financial favor is upon my life. People give to me. Opportunities find me. Resources locate me. Wealth flows to me. I shall not struggle. I shall not lack. I shall not beg. My God supplies all my needs according to his riches in glory by Christ Jesus. Robbo chandela shaba komos shandanda fire fire. Now let's pray over your health. Father in the name of Jesus I speak life to my body. I declare that divine health is my portion. I declare that supernatural strength is my reality. I speak to every organ in my body and I command it to function perfectly. Heart pump with the rhythm of heaven. Lungs breathe with the breath of God. Kidneys filter with divine precision. Liver process with supernatural efficiency. Brain operate [clears throat] with heavenly clarity. I cause every seed of sickness. I cause every root of disease. I cause every foundation of infirmity be uprooted, be destroyed, be consumed by the fire of the Holy Ghost. Cancer, I command you to die. Diabetes, I command you to leave. High blood pressure, I command you to normalize. Heart disease, I command you to be healed. Kidney failure, I command you to be reversed. Every diagnosis, I command you to be cancelled. By the stripes of Jesus, I am healed. By his wounds I am made whole. By his blood I am delivered. By his power I am restored. I shall not die but live and declare the works of the Lord. I shall see my children's children. I shall complete my assignment. I shall fulfill my purpose. I shall finish my course. Sickness is illegal in my body. Disease has no right to my organs. Pain must flee from my bones. Infirmity must depart from my flesh. I am healed. I am whole. I am strong. I am healthy. Shababa komoshandi robo chandela. Hallelujah. I'm receiving a word of knowledge. There's someone listening who has been experiencing severe headaches, migraines that come without warning, pain so intense that you can barely function. You've taken medication but the relief is temporary. the headaches keep returning. [music] I speak to those headaches in the name of Jesus. I command the root cause to be addressed. [music] I command every blood vessel in your brain to function normally. I command every nerve to operate correctly. I command your brain chemistry to be balanced. I command those migraines to end permanently. You will never experience that level of pain again. The course is [music] broken. The cycle is ended. You are free. receive your healing. Now, there's someone else. You have been dealing with back pain. It has affected your ability to walk, your ability to sleep, your ability to enjoy life. You've tried everything, but nothing seems to work permanently. I speak to your spine in the [clears throat] name of Jesus. I command every vertebrae to align perfectly. I command every disc to be restored. I command every nerve to function without interference. I command every muscle to relax and strengthen. I command that back pain to leave and never return. Stand up straight. Walk without limping. Sleep without discomfort. Walk without restriction. You are healed. Receive it now. There's someone with anxiety. Not just regular worry, crippling anxiety, panic attacks, racing heart, difficulty breathing, overwhelming fear that comes out of nowhere. I speak to that spirit of anxiety in the name of Jesus. I command you to lose your hold. I command you to release your grip. I command you to depart from this life. You have no authority. You have no right. You must go now. I release the peace of God that passes all understanding. I release divine calm into your mind. I release heavenly tranquility into your soul. Anxiety is broken. Fear is shattered. Panic is destroyed. You shall live in peace. Receive your deliverance now. Robo Chandela Shababa Shandai. Yes, Lord. Now, let's pray over your marriage. Father, in the name of Jesus, I speak over marriages. I declare that supernatural favor rests upon marriages. I declare that divine love flows through marriages. I declare that heavenly peace fills marriages. Every spirit of division that has been assigned to marriages, I command it to scatter now. Every spirit of strife that has been causing conflict, I command it to leave now. Every spirit of infidelity that has been tempting spouses, I command it to be bound now. I speak love into marriages. I speak communication into marriages. I speak understanding into marriages. I speak intimacy into marriages. I speak passion into marriages. I speak commitment into marriages. For those who are believing for marriage, I declare that your spouse is located. Divine connection is happening. The right person is being prepared. Delay is broken. Obstacles are removed. Your wedding day is approaching. For those who are married, I declare that your marriage is strengthened. Your bond is deepened. Your love is renewed. Your commitment is reinforced. Your unity is sealed. No weapon formed against marriages shall prosper. No curse spoken against marriages shall stand. No attack launched against marriages shall succeed. Marriages are blessed. Marriages are protected. Marriages are preserved. Marriages are thriving. Shabbab komos shandai robo chandela has broken your heart. But the Lord is saying to you what men meant for evil. I am turning for your good. The betrayal was a setup for elevation. Those who left were making room for those who are coming. I am surrounding you with covenant people. Divine connections are being established even now. Your season of betrayal is ending. Your season of divine alignment is beginning. Receive it. Shaba komo shandai. Now I'm going to seal this prayer. I'm going to close this encounter with prophetic declarations that will follow you throughout this day and this week. Wherever you are, lift your hands one more time. I decree and declare over your life, the struggle is over. From this 5:00 a.m. prayer, supernatural favor has taken over. You will no longer fight battles that produce no victory. You will no longer toil without results. You will no longer labor without harvest. I decree that doors are opening for you today before the sun sets. You will receive good news. Before this week ends, you will have a testimony. I decree that favor is surrounding you as a shield. Everywhere you go today, favor goes before you. Everyone you meet today, favor speaks for you. I decree that your family is protected, your marriage is preserved, your children are covered, your finances are blessed, your health is secured. I decree that every seed the enemy planted is uprooted. Every plan of hell is canled. Every agenda of darkness is destroyed. I seal this day with the blood of Jesus. I seal this week with the blood of Jesus. I seal this month with the blood of Jesus. I seal this year with the blood of Jesus. No weapon formed against you shall prosper. No tongue rising against you shall stand. No enemy attacking you shall succeed. Walk into your day with confidence. Walk into your week with authority. Walk into your season with power. You are favored. You are blessed. You are chosen. You are victorious. Robocandala shaba komos shandai. It is done. It is finished. It is sealed [music] in the mighty name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth. Amen and amen. Hallelujah. Now, share this message. Let someone else receive this word. Be a blessing to someone today. And remember, wake up at 5:00 a.m. and pray. This is your strategy. This is your weapon. This is your key to supernatural favor. Go in peace. Go in power. Go in victory. God bless you.
